recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic take down the Bucks for their 1st home win, improve to 2-0 in NBA Cup play: “Whether it was the players or the coaches, putting everything they had into the game, I thought was great,” Orlando’s Sean Sweeney said. https://t.co/DfLPxqfxOD
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: “We’re starting to find a little bit of a recipe, a little bit of an identity, especially on the defensive end,” #Magic guard Desmond Bane said after Friday’s Cup win vs. Milwaukee. “… I think we're trending in the right direction on that end of the floor.” Full remarks: https://t.co/1H4PXqgoRx
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said they were just trying to manage the game for Jalen Suggs when I asked what went into him coming off the bench in his first game back from injury. “But his impact was felt immediately and … he impacts the game in so many different areas…” More: https://t.co/lR2tyQY310
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: #Magic forward Franz Wagner gave a very Franz Wagner-esque answer when I asked him about losing his triple-double: “Yeah, tough one. I mean, it would have been nice obviously but I think all you can do is play your minutes as best as you can. … I’m happy about the win.” More: https://t.co/lELmdd5sCX
recent.author: Jason Beede
recent.quoted_text: Here’s the new explanation as to why #Magic’s Franz Wagner had 9 rebounds tonight, per @Magic_PR: At 1:55 of the *2nd* quarter vs. Milwaukee, the NBA ruled that Goga Bitadze had a controlled tip, which counts as a rebound. With that, it takes one rebound away from Wagner.

recent.text: Despite the #Bucks' red-hot shooting in the third quarter, the #Magic have kept them at bay. They are scoring mostly behind Franz Wagner's gravity. Desmond Bane made five threes in the quarter. Magic lead the Bucks 84-72 after three quarters.
